expectations.text: The audit points out that because /checkout/ is disallowed in robots.txt, Google cannot crawl the page and so cannot see its noindex tag, meaning the URL can still be indexed
expectations.evidence: Finding 1: 'robots.txt blocks Google from crawling /checkout/, so Google never sees the page's noindex, and the URL can still be indexed.'

expectations.text: The audit states that Google does not support the crawl-delay field in robots.txt
expectations.evidence: 'Crawl-delay: 10 ... Google does not support this field and ignores it', linked to the robots.txt spec page.

expectations.text: The audit states that a Noindex rule in robots.txt is not supported by Google
expectations.evidence: Finding 5: 'a noindex rule in robots.txt is not supported'.

expectations.text: The audit states that the Sitemap line in robots.txt must be a fully qualified (absolute) URL
expectations.evidence: Finding 4: 'the value must be a fully qualified URL including protocol and host'.

expectations.text: The audit states that the AggregateRating is missing a required count property (ratingCount or reviewCount)
expectations.evidence: 'aggregateRating has no ratingCount or reviewCount. At least one of the two is required.'

expectations.text: The audit points out that the product rating marked up in the JSON-LD is not visible in the page content (or that the markup does not represent the main content of this page), which conflicts with Google's structured data guidelines
expectations.evidence: 'The 4.9 rating appears nowhere in the visible page' and 'The page is an order confirmation, not a page about the kettle', both tied to the structured data guidelines.

expectations.text: The audit clearly separates required fixes or violations from optional recommendations
The audit links to at least two developers.google.com documentation pages that back up its findings
expectations.evidence: Every finding links to a developers.google.com page (block-indexing, robots intro, sd-policies, review-snippet, product-snippet, robots-txt-spec and others).
